title: Out-of-Network Balance Cap Ratio on Member Appeals to Plans Paying Second — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — member appeals to an out-of-network plan that pays second.** The second-plan member appeal's cap ratio measures how much of the coverage's recent out-of-network experience fell to the member as a balance rather than being written off.

## Clause

The second-plan member appeal's cap ratio is:

1. the out-of-network balance assigned to the member on the coverage within the last six months, divided by that balance plus the contractual adjustments on the coverage within the same six months, where such a balance exists;
2. the same ratio taken over the last twelve months, where no such balance falls within six months but one falls within twelve months;
3. one, otherwise.

Under the second-plan member appeal, the contested charges are multiplied by the cap ratio.

*Out-of-network balance* means patient-responsibility lines of the out-of-network balance type on the coverage; other responsibility types do not enter the ratio.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical coverage)

| Out-of-network balance, last six months | Out-of-network balance, last twelve months | Contractual adjustments in the matching window | Cap ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 120.00 | 280.00 in six months | 120.00 divided by 400.00: 0.30 |
| 0.00 | 90.00 | 210.00 in twelve months | 90.00 divided by 300.00: 0.30 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | — | 1 |

Applied to hypothetical contested charges of 500.00 USD, a cap ratio of 0.30 gives 150.00 USD.
